_fixture: Cases replayed by `./tools/check-cargo-lanes.py --self-test`. Each fixture text is checked against the real `.github/workflows/ci.yml` contract in tools/cargo-lanes.json, so the expectations cannot drift away from the live rules.

cases.name: ci-complete
cases.why: A trimmed but contract-complete workflow must be accepted, so a failing negative case cannot be explained by a rule that rejects everything.

cases.name: ci-missing-static-linkage
cases.why: Deleting the static gtk4-layer-shell linkage step silently weakens CI, which .github/AGENTS.md forbids.
cases.expect_error_contains: occurrence(s) of the allowlisted command `cargo build --locked --bin wayscriber`

cases.name: ci-stale-clippy-command
cases.why: A replaced raw command must not come back beside the driver call.
cases.expect_error_contains: the raw command `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` is back

cases.name: ci-duplicate-driver-call
cases.why: Each routed consumer must be invoked exactly once per entry point.
cases.expect_error_contains: expected exactly one `./tools/run-cargo-consumer.py ci-ubuntu` invocation, found 2

cases.name: ci-missing-arch-gate
cases.why: Dropping the Arch job would leave the config-modern lane uncompiled by any hosted check.
cases.expect_error_contains: expected exactly one `./tools/run-cargo-consumer.py ci-arch` invocation, found 0

cases.name: ci-unallowlisted-cargo
cases.why: A new raw workspace Cargo command outside the manifest and the allowlist must fail.

cases.name: ci-env-prefixed-cargo
cases.why: The same raw command behind an environment assignment must fail too. `RUSTFLAGS=... cargo test` does not start the line, so a start-of-line or after-an-operator detector passes it, and the workflow compiles a vector no lane describes.

cases.name: ci-wrapped-cargo
cases.why: A wrapper program with its own operands hides the command just as well: `timeout -k 10 300 cargo test` must be read past the wrapper, its option, and both bare numbers before the head is judged.

cases.name: ci-shell-control-cargo
cases.why: A shell control word and the `command` builtin are prefixes, not exemptions; the command after them must still be judged.

cases.name: ci-env-option-cargo
cases.why: The operand of `env -u` belongs to the wrapper; it must be consumed before the wrapped Cargo command is judged.

cases.name: ci-sudo-option-cargo
cases.why: The user operand of `sudo -u` belongs to the wrapper; it must not hide the Cargo command that follows.

cases.name: ci-shell-evaluator-cargo
cases.why: A command string passed to `bash -c` is still executed by the entry point and must be scanned for raw Cargo commands.

cases.name: ci-path-qualified-cargo
cases.why: Same fixture, other half of the rule: spelling the program with a directory must not launder it, and the reported command keeps the path so it cannot be mistaken for the allowlisted spelling.

cases.name: ci-unknown-consumer
cases.why: A driver call naming a consumer the manifest does not declare must fail while the workflow is read, not when the job reaches the step.
cases.expect_error_contains: which is not a consumer declared in tools/cargo-lanes.json

cases.name: coverage-complete
cases.why: A loader entry point that imports tools/cargo_lanes.py and names its consumer must be accepted, so the negative case below cannot be explained by a rule that rejects every checker text.

cases.name: coverage-missing-loader
cases.why: The one entry point that consumes its vectors through the loader instead of the driver must keep doing so; with the import and the consumer name gone, the source-coverage matrix forks from tools/cargo-lanes.json and manifest edits stop reaching this gate.
cases.expect_error_contains: expected the file to consume the `source-coverage` operations through

cases.name: coverage-missing-loader-import
cases.why: Same fixture, the other half of the loader rule: with the import gone the file cannot be reading the manifest, whatever names it still contains.
cases.expect_error_contains: expected the file to import tools/cargo_lanes.py

cases.name: coverage-missing-import
cases.why: The state a name-presence rule cannot see: the vectors are inlined and the import is gone, but the consumer name survives in a printed label. Without the import assertion this file passes the loader rule while the manifest reaches nothing in it.
cases.expect_error_contains: expected the file to import tools/cargo_lanes.py

cases.name: coverage-unused-loader-import
cases.why: An unused loader import beside inlined Cargo vectors must not satisfy the contract; the checker has to read the routed consumer's operations from the manifest.
cases.expect_error_contains: does not read its operations from `load_manifest().consumer(...)`
